name: PLASMA THAWING BATH
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Plasma Thawing Bath is a highly critical clinical instrument used exclusively in blood banks and hospital trauma centers. It is designed to safely and rapidly thaw Fresh Frozen Plasma (FFP) and cryoprecipitate bags. Engineered to maintain a constant 37°C with an internal centrifugal water circulation pump, it preserves coagulation factors, ensuring immediate patient readiness with a rapid thaw time of 20-25 minutes.
features: Maintains constant critical temperature at 37°C with ±0.5°C accuracy
Rapid thaw time of approximately 20 to 25 minutes
Centrifugal water circulation pump for unmatched temperature uniformity
In-built programmable timer with an END process alert buzzer
Includes a removable Stainless Steel tray to securely hold plasma bags
Designed for continuous operation with low energy consumption

specifications.Bag Capacity: Up to 15 bags (300 ml) or 12 bags (450 ml)
specifications.Temperature Controller: PID controller with in-built timer & buzzer
